CENTRALIZED_LAWS.text:
C1 Non-rewriting Temporal Truth [grade A]
SHARED: Later current knowledge/state may supersede a present projection without rewriting what was historically admitted, observed or true-at-the-time. Currentness and history are separate queries.
BOUNDARY: Does not imply one universal temporal schema. Effective time, knowledge time, authority epoch, generation and task revision remain owner-native.
ORIGINS: finance=FR2 effective time vs observed_at; append-only regime revisions; no future leakage.; security=Authority changes are prospective; earlier valid admissions/evidence remain immutable history.; workstation=Generation/watchdog currentness supersedes stale admission-fence interpretation without pretending the old fence never existed.; runtime=Registry/Attempt history and late evidence correct current resolution without erasing earlier uncertainty.; host=Event journal/revisions preserve semantic history while current checkpoint is a projection.

C2 UNKNOWN Is a First-Class Action State [grade A]
SHARED: Missing, stale, conflicting or insufficient evidence must not be collapsed into false, absent, failed or safe-to-retry when those states imply different next actions.
BOUNDARY: Shared semantic inequality only; each owner defines its own unknown causes and recovery action.
ORIGINS: runtime=Lost/orphaned/commitState unknown prevent speculative redispatch.; finance=FR2 transition windows and FR3 carrier evidence return UNKNOWN rather than fabricated exact identity/quality.; world=Evidence actionability/claim support can remain unresolved; empty observation is not global absence.; security=Currentness/evidence and authority experiments preserve unresolved states.; human=Challenge/unresolved discriminator and correct abstention are review states.

C3 Projection Is Not Authority [grade B]
SHARED: A selected/current/derived view may be useful without becoming the source of truth or gaining mutation/semantic authority over what it projects.
BOUNDARY: Does not require identical projection data structures or a central view service.
ORIGINS: computing=Core A6: Context is selected view of separately owned state.; finance=Current relation is disposable projection; temporal identity evidence remains canonical.; world=ActionableEvidenceFor is decision-scoped projection over evidence/claims, not a new evidence owner.; human=C1 Boundary can be inherited from owner/Task/Run contract rather than copied into packet authority.; web=Project quick index derives from canonical project array and does not become second directory authority.

C4 Identity Is Bound to Relevant Invariants, Not Labels or Bytes [grade A]
SHARED: Continuity depends on preserving the invariants that give an object/commitment meaning; byte equality, ticker/name equality, or implementation revision alone is neither necessary nor sufficient.
BOUNDARY: No universal identity tuple follows; each owner must name its non-bypassable invariants.
ORIGINS: computing=PAL F19 old Run survives Harness implementation change when lineage/commitment/authority/evidence invariants remain.; finance=FR2 ticker is label not identity; identity events can change reference semantics without changing economic object.; workstation=Network capability identity binds path/generation/current evidence, not friendly node/profile name.; security=Authority digest/producer/key/version identity survives rotation and binds historical verification.; runtime=clientRequestId/Operation identity binds enforceable request facts; replay must not reinterpret current world.

C5 Evidence Availability Is Not Knowledge/Promotion Authority [grade A]
SHARED: Evidence can exist, recur, or be retrievable without earning stable Knowledge, Core doctrine, or future decision authority. Promotion is a separate evidence decision.
BOUNDARY: Does not define one universal Knowledge object or promotion daemon.
ORIGINS: world=R8 separates Evidence existence, actionability, claim support and Knowledge.; human=Promotion Gate requires support maturity + falsifier/boundary + implementation-independent representation; recurrence/control value alone insufficient.; harness=Reusable procedural knowledge topology and Run authority remain separate; new installed cognition does not silently enter old Run.; computing=World Model Loop promotes only after cross-project evidence; local observations stay owner facts.

C6 Capability, Authority, Commitment and Consequence Are Distinct [grade B]
SHARED: Being able to perform an operation does not grant authority; admitting/committing it does not prove the external consequence occurred; process completion does not prove domain completion.
BOUNDARY: No single permission/effect object should own all stages; ownership remains domain-specific.
ORIGINS: runtime=Effect kernel: Proposal != commitment; execution result != external effect receipt != semantic completion.; workstation=Semantic MCP narrows exact network authority and prohibited effects despite generic root execution capability.; finance=Carrier/admission/capital authority and external effect/reconciliation remain distinct.; security=Frozen grant/authority digest, admission and evidence are separate.; human=Joint capability and decision authority are not equivalent.

C7 Contraction and Deletion Are Epistemic Operators [grade B]
SHARED: Removing, narrowing or localizing a structure is an experiment: survival reveals a smaller invariant; breakage reveals what the layer actually owned. Historical evidence need not imply active executability.
BOUNDARY: Deletion is not a universal default for participant-owned data, legal records, unique evidence or irreversible external state.
ORIGINS: computing=TM0 RT8 and Existence Gauntlet; deletion tests required before shared-layer promotion.; game=GC1/GC2/GC6 remove zero-consumer or duplicate semantics while preserving product/recovery equivalence.; human=AE1/C1 deletion falsifiers and evidence-first contraction remove standing batteries/services.; computing-pal=13 closed PAL apparatus elements removed after evidence became durable.; web=Spacing-only candidate discarded after real render failure rather than accumulated as compatibility.

C8 Reversibility Expands Search, but Recovery Does Not Erase Consequence [grade B]
SHARED: Cheap reversible interior experimentation expands the practical hypothesis frontier; irreversible/shared effects require narrower commitment/reconciliation, and recovery cannot pretend an outside consequence did not happen.
BOUNDARY: Simulation/reversibility cannot substitute for real social/economic/adversarial consequence evidence.
ORIGINS: runtime=Disposable Workspaces, exact replay, UNKNOWN and effect reconciliation.; computing=Core A8/A11 and TM0 RT5.; security=Self-owned bounded labs allow aggressive falsification while third-party consequence remains excluded.; human=Error/recovery work values bounded failure and recovery, not first-try correctness.; studio=Editable source + reproducible render + approved Output separates reversible iteration from publication.

C9 Consumer Pressure Determines Layer Admission [grade C]
SHARED: A lower/shared layer should change only after a reproduced consumer failure proves higher owner-local treatment insufficient; stop descent at the first truthful successful treatment.
BOUNDARY: Some failures may legitimately begin in a lower layer; the rule is causal localization, not mandatory sequential edits.
ORIGINS: game=Two ordinary consumer failures stopped at L2 expression; no deeper rewrite.; web=Directory problem solved by local canonical-data projection after spacing-only failure; no Core aesthetic law.; studio=First ordinary production succeeded with a production-local omission fix; architecture stayed unchanged.; computing=A13 and provider/consumer-first research method encode burden before abstraction.

C10 Current Use, Option Value and Capability Value Are Distinct [grade B]
SHARED: Zero current consumption does not imply zero future option value; possible future value also does not justify retaining everything. Value depends on reacquisition/carrying cost, future workloads, authority and conversion into capability/effect.
BOUNDARY: No universal option-value scalar or retain/delete rule is supported.
ORIGINS: computing=PAL P2 scoped egress later gained Finance/Workstation use; F11 rejected generic option-aware retention.; world=Resource -> actionable option/capability/effect conversion and demand-scoped ecology.; human=Future Control Value distinguishes knowledge worth internalizing from merely retrievable durable facts.; studio=Installed/provisional equipment worlds are not mature creative capability until real work consumes them.

C11 Stop When Further Evidence Cannot Change the Current Decision [grade B]
SHARED: Research completion is not plan completion or mutation count; lawful abstention/stopping is progress when available next observations have poor decision-changing information value relative to cost.
BOUNDARY: No global observation threshold; new capability/cheap evidence may reopen the frontier.
ORIGINS: human=Task search model completion conditions and R5/R6 evidence-first contraction.; computing=TM0 RT10/RT12 and Harness P4 observation-efficiency pressure.; finance=GVA/alpha research funnels allow zero survivors/zero effects; negative/no-attempt outcomes close branches.; game=GX1 stops saturated live-model repetitions/timeouts when evidence is already discriminative.

C12 Shared Semantics Do Not Imply Shared Mechanism [grade B]
SHARED: The same semantic distinction recurring across owners is evidence for a shared claim only after recurrence; it does not by itself justify a central implementation, schema or service.
BOUNDARY: A central mechanism is still justified when a truly unowned non-bypassable responsibility recurs and deletion breaks multiple workloads.
ORIGINS: computing=A13, World Model Loop and TM0 RT7 explicitly require materially different recurrence + deletion test.; world=R7/R8 prefer owner-native claims/projections over universal ecology/evidence managers.; finance=GVA rejects universal OpportunityKernel; FR2 persists owner-specific immutable datasets rather than generic graph engine.; security=CA-LIC laws inform engineering but do not earn license/revocation/DRM service.; game=Multi-credential provider machinery remains local until second real consumer reproduces responsibility.

FULL_EAGER.text:
CASE OFR3-RUNTIME-01 | OWNER runtime | Physical realization must not change the target world to satisfy evidence
INVARIANT: Runtime may strengthen executable/provider realization evidence only while preserving the target-visible execution semantics it claims to execute; ambiguous or drifting path realization fails rather than silently substituting a different world.
RIVAL: Make sealed-memfd execution the default after admission so the exact validated bytes are what execute; alternatively use a single-file read-only bind.
WHY ATTRACTIVE: Both are stronger-looking immutability mechanisms. Sealed memfd closes pathname replacement races and gives exact executable bytes even after the original path changes.
FALSIFIER: The single-file systemd read-only bind did not stabilize future pathname resolution when the parent directory entry was replaced. Sealed memfd did execute exact ELF/shebang bytes, but changed `__file__`, `sys.argv[0]`, and `/proc/self/exe`; the stronger evidence mechanism changed target-observable semantics.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Keep the original pathname semantics, witness declared dependency/executable paths through execution, fail on detected runtime drift, and bind the Runtime-owned Runner provider independently.
COUNTERFACTUAL: A default memfd substitution would make programs observe a different executable/script location than the one the caller requested. Debugging, self-location, module/resource discovery and provenance could become semantically false even though byte identity is stronger.
BOUNDARY: This rejects memfd as the universal default, not memfd as a tool. A workload that explicitly treats pathname semantics as irrelevant may still choose a stronger immutable-byte mechanism. It also does not claim complete ambient dependency closure.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen if Runtime can preserve both immutable execution bytes and the target-visible pathname semantics required by a real workload, or if a caller explicitly admits a semantics-changing immutable execution mode.

CASE OFR3-HOST-01 | OWNER host | Task continuity does not require a generic Host-owned Effect lifecycle
INVARIANT: Host owns durable Task/revision/commitment continuity and referenced uncertainty/evidence; executor/domain-specific effect lifecycles remain with the narrow workload owner instead of a universal Host Effect abstraction.
RIVAL: `EffectLifecycleHost` plus generic `DispatchEnvelope`, executor-neutral `deliver/observe/reconcile`, Observation/Verification/Outcome state, reused across Runtime, Game and other executors.
WHY ATTRACTIVE: It offered one elegant response-loss and effect-lifecycle story for multiple executors, with a common WAITING/VERIFYING path and no-blind-redelivery behavior.
FALSIFIER: The generic lifecycle was fully implemented and tested, then commit `06ef7a394b136cefee5812d9fc990a30061585ea` deleted roughly 1.4k lines of lifecycle/executor/Game-workload apparatus because no production consumer earned it. Current Host architecture records that the former candidate duplicated specialized read, mutation, code-change and Harness paths; later cleanup removed remaining residue.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Keep one Task Journal/CAS projection, revision/lease fencing, explicit commitment/uncertainty and external-executor references. Let each workload own the smallest effect/reconciliation semantics required to produce Host-visible facts.
COUNTERFACTUAL: Restoring the generic lifecycle would create two semantic recovery authorities around Runtime/Harness/domain effects, invite Host to interpret effect semantics it cannot verify, and reintroduce a large abstraction whose current consumers already have narrower owners.
BOUNDARY: Host may still own caller-neutral external-executor request/binding/observation because those are Task-continuity facts. The rejected model is the universal executor-neutral semantic Effect lifecycle, not every cross-executor interface.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen only if at least two materially different production workloads reproduce the same unowned effect-lifecycle responsibility and deleting the shared layer creates measurable duplication or recovery failure.

CASE OFR3-HARNESS-01 | OWNER harness | Storage persistence is not cognition persistence or Run authority
INVARIANT: Materialized source bytes, reusable-source existence, current durable cognition, and future Run admission are separate facts. Cross-Run knowledge becomes current cognition only through explicit exact selection under the new Run authority.
RIVAL: Add a Harness Memory/Skill repository or promotion state machine that automatically turns materialized/extracted/promoted knowledge into future cognition.
WHY ATTRACTIVE: Automatic persistent memory appears to reduce repeated selection work and makes cross-Run learning look simpler: once K exists or is promoted, inject it into later Runs.
FALSIFIER: P-C1.7 materialized K while A remained current: when the Agent selected only A, K stayed physically readable in CAS but never appeared in the successor or fresh-process model view. When selected, A+K survived attempt/process boundaries; when later omitted, K left current cognition while its immutable bytes remained. P1 therefore reproduced durable reuse without a new Memory/Promotion subsystem.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Use exact external reusable references/resolution plus the existing cognition seed/WorkingSet selection path. External owners evaluate/promote semantics; Harness makes exact reuse admissible but does not decide what deserves persistence.
COUNTERFACTUAL: Automatic injection would turn storage existence or an external label into semantic Run authority, allow stale/irrelevant material into future model views, and make Harness a hidden knowledge evaluator instead of a structural cognition substrate.
BOUNDARY: The result proves authority/state semantics, not that a real model will make good long-term memory choices. Harness still supports exact cross-Run reuse and may expose history without semantic search/ranking.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen only if a real second consumer shows that explicit exact selection cannot express required reusable cognition or creates recurring cost that a narrower shared repository can reduce without granting hidden semantic authority.

CASE OFR3-WORLD-01 | OWNER world | Resource dynamics are owner-native claims/events, not one universal Resource state machine
INVARIANT: Resource identity remains separate from optional owner-native quantity/rate/capacity/currentness/authority/materialization/maintenance claims and reserve/release/consume/renew events. World derives demand-scoped ecology projections only when a consumer needs them.
RIVAL: A universal scalar stock account (A), universal stock-flow-capacity vector (B), or exactly one canonical family-specific lifecycle per Resource (C).
WHY ATTRACTIVE: Inventory/accounting models are compact and familiar; the vector can absorb many quantitative cases; family-specific lifecycle C preserves heterogeneity while offering a global taxonomy.
FALSIFIER: Across 50 frozen discriminators A scored 16 PASS/24 FAIL/10 AMBIG, B 19/21/10, strengthened C 39/0/11, while owner-native model D scored 50/0/0; ten post-freeze falsifiers also passed without changing D. Network currentness, relation-scoped availability, non-rival knowledge, authority expiry, replica/materialization and reservation/release repeatedly broke depletion/state-machine intuitions. C was not declared false; its family registry simply added no demonstrated decision value.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Persist native dynamic truth where its owner needs history/currentness, and project only the coordinates required by the named transition. Do not add a central `ResourceState`, family registry, universal quantity table or global unit conversion.
COUNTERFACTUAL: A/B would fabricate stock/depletion semantics for routes, authority and reusable knowledge; C would force canonical family ownership for multi-aspect resources and could turn explanatory taxonomy into execution authority without changing predictions.
BOUNDARY: D is provisional research, not canonical World doctrine. R7 also found a real quantitative projection gap; the result forbids overgeneralizing the fix, not adding demand-earned quantitative claims.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen when a stronger universal/family model survives an equally strong frozen corpus with lower ownership/representation cost, or a real consumer proves owner-native projection cannot answer its transition efficiently.

CASE OFR3-HUMAN-01 | OWNER human | Recurrence and control value are not stable-core promotion authority
INVARIANT: Choose knowledge representation granularity and allocation using Durability × Future Control Value, but stable-core promotion is a separate evidence decision requiring support maturity appropriate to scope, an explicit boundary/falsifier, and an implementation-independent representation.
RIVAL: Promote high-durability/high-control or repeatedly recurring cross-project structures directly into the Human stable core.
WHY ATTRACTIVE: Recurrence across many projects/epochs and high future control value look like exactly what a small stable core should retain; an extra gate appears redundant.
FALSIFIER: AE1 ablation has one explicit mismatch only when the Promotion Gate is removed: AE-K15. The claim “R1–R8 structures recur enough to be universal laws” is high durability/high control but has `support_maturity_established=false` and no explicit boundary/falsifier because source-bias/taxonomy concerns remain. Without the gate it is over-promoted.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Treat recurrence/control value as evidence that a representation is worth understanding/reviewing, not as authority to canonize it. Preserve mechanism-level status until support and falsification boundary earn stable-core admission.
COUNTERFACTUAL: A recurrence-only rule would harden shared prompts, architecture ancestry or measurement taxonomy into “universal” Human knowledge, making later contradiction psychologically/operationally more expensive and reducing epistemic optionality.
BOUNDARY: The current gate is an Ordivon-specific supported candidate derived from selected cases, not a universal education curriculum or claim that all stable knowledge needs identical evidence forms.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen when natural use finds a repeatedly decision-useful representation blocked without reason, or a promoted item should have been rejected for a dimension the three-part gate cannot express.

CASE OFR3-FINANCE-01 | OWNER finance | Financial instrument identity requires temporal relations and knowledge time
INVARIANT: Ticker/label is not identity authority. Finance represents one economic object through temporal venue/instrument relation intervals and explicit identity/reference events, with effective time distinct from `observed_at` knowledge time; unresolved transition windows return UNKNOWN and later evidence appends rather than rewrites earlier knowledge.
RIVAL: A symbol-keyed enriched current record (A), or stable economic object plus only the current venue/instrument relation (B).
WHY ATTRACTIVE: Both are dramatically simpler than a temporal dataset and satisfy ordinary current lookup. B already fixes many cross-domain and instrument-type semantics.
FALSIFIER: A fails on QNT cross-domain ticker collision and SPCX rename/conversion history. B loses SPCX pre-IPO share-estimate/rebase/listed regimes, cannot make historical comparability/invalidation deterministic, and requires prose reconstruction for PIT queries. Writing a future `validTo` into the original observation leaks future knowledge; collapsing history into the current row deletes invalidation targets.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Persist immutable identity intervals/events as A2 datasets, append later observations of the same regime with supersession links, keep bounded UNKNOWN windows, and treat current relation as a disposable projection.
COUNTERFACTUAL: A/B would create symbol collisions, look-ahead leakage, silently splice reference regimes, and make backtests/research validate with information Finance did not possess at the historical decision time.
BOUNDARY: FR2 owns identity/reference meaning only. It does not create a universal graph engine, replace portfolio exposure, market observation, beliefs or current effect-bound venue metadata.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen if a smaller model answers current and PIT identity, cross-domain disambiguation, historical invalidation and transition uncertainty without future leakage.

CASE OFR3-WORKSTATION-01 | OWNER workstation | Recovery of a selected path must not silently become a new selection
INVARIANT: `path.revalidate` re-qualifies one exact prior observation/path and cannot enumerate or select alternatives; negative revalidation does not overwrite the saved observation; an active anchor under a different selection is a conflict; published egress is generation/currentness-bound and fails closed when its parent changes.
RIVAL: Treat recovery as rediscovery/failover: if the saved path is stale or unhealthy, automatically choose the best currently working endpoint/protocol/path under the same revalidation/recovery operation.
WHY ATTRACTIVE: It maximizes apparent liveness and hides provider/path outages from consumers; a generic “ensure network works” primitive is simpler for Agents.
FALSIFIER: Current owner tests make the rival mechanically impossible: source-observation drift fails before network effects; binding drift creates no tunnel; exact revalidation asserts endpoint enumeration is never called; successful revalidation returns `selectionMutationAllowed=false` and one preserved path; negative results are never persisted as a replacement observation; active different selection raises `ANCHOR_SELECTION_CONFLICT`. Earlier NX0.2 half-dead transport recovery similarly rebuilds the same admitted path or terminates the generation rather than reselecting.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Separate discovery/selection from exact revalidation/admission. Bind semantic tools to exact observation/path/generation, and require explicit replacement/new admission for a different selection.
COUNTERFACTUAL: A caller asking “is this exact route still valid?” could silently receive a different endpoint/provider/protocol/region. That would destroy causal identity, currentness provenance and any downstream security/venue assumptions tied to the selected path while reporting recovery success.
BOUNDARY: A distinct product whose semantics are explicitly “best current path” may own automatic selection. The invariant applies when the operation claims continuity/revalidation of an already selected identity.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen only if a real consumer explicitly grants reselection authority and can bind the resulting new path identity/side effects without presenting it as continuity of the old selection.

CASE OFR3-SECURITY-01 | OWNER security | Authority revocation is prospective; delivered information and historical admission remain facts
INVARIANT: Consequential Security admission binds an exact authority snapshot/digest. Later authority revision controls future admission but does not rewrite historically valid decisions, delivered bytes/results or the producer identity required to verify old evidence.
RIVAL: Model revocation/current authority as retroactive: once a grant is revoked or key rotated, past local authority/results should be treated as no longer valid/known, and current authority identity is sufficient for all verification.
WHY ATTRACTIVE: A single mutable “current entitlement” is simple and feels safer: revoke once and make all old rights/results disappear from the active model.
FALSIFIER: Self-owned ToyDesigner V5 showed revoking Alice cannot retract an already delivered key/plaintext; rotation only protects future releases. V6 TTL sweeps measured offline survivability equal to worst-case stale-revocation window. V8 showed old signed receipts require retained old authority identity after key rotation, while future calls can be denied immediately. The R1 runner passes 26/26 structural gates for these distinctions.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Freeze exact grant snapshots in Range/Evaluation specs, record the `authorityDigest` that admitted each effect, create new authority revisions prospectively, and preserve historical producer/key identity for retained evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL: Retroactive current-authority semantics would corrupt audit history, claim impossible “take-back” of delivered information, make old receipts unverifiable after rotation, and conflate future permission with past occurrence.
BOUNDARY: This does not say revoked actors retain future authority. Security may deny future actions, destroy owned disposable worlds, or mark credentials no longer current. The irreversibility applies to past facts/delivered information, not future permission.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen when a real persistent Security world needs grants to change mid-session, cached disconnected authority, non-exportable hardware operations, remote protected capability, or provider/key migration with historical verification.

CASE OFR3-GAME-01 | OWNER game | Plan Preview is durable cognition/product state but not World commitment
INVARIANT: Commander Order, sealed Plan Preview, explicit Commit and deterministic World consequence are distinct states. Preview is retained/recoverable and inspectable but has no World authority until explicit Commit binds the selected Preview to canonical faction plans/Turn Batch.
RIVAL: Collapse planning and commitment: let model/policy plan generation directly occupy faction plan slots or mutate World, or treat Preview as ephemeral UI decoration with no authoritative identity.
WHY ATTRACTIVE: Fewer states and less persistence: generate plans, execute them, and render whatever was generated as a preview.
FALSIFIER: P3 tests explicitly verify Preview non-authority before Commit. Changing the mutable Order invalidates/clears the Preview without touching World or P2 plan slots. The selected Preview survives restart before Commit; partial plan submission/P2 preparation resumes the same Preview/Batch; response-lost World results are observed under the original Turn Batch before a new Planning Head.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Persist Order/Preview identity/digests, expose player review, require explicit Commit, reuse selected Preview across restart/partial submission, and separate World effect receipts from planning state.
COUNTERFACTUAL: Direct plan-to-effect would let model generation or browser refresh commit consequences without player authority, make re-planning ambiguous, and allow response loss to create duplicate/replacement turns. Ephemeral Preview would break audit/restart fidelity and “what exactly did I commit?” review.
BOUNDARY: This is a Station Zero product invariant. It supports a broader proposal/commit inequality but does not prove every Agent/game UI requires the same Preview object or explicit button.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen if a different Game mode deliberately grants autonomous plan authority, or a smaller product state preserves player agency, restart/recovery and exact committed-plan review.

CASE OFR3-WEB-01 | OWNER web | An index whose primary task is selection must expose selectable entities, not only taxonomy
INVARIANT: For the current Projects directory, initial desktop/mobile orientation must expose actual Project identities/links. The quick index derives from the same canonical `projects` array; detailed taxonomy/capability cards remain below.
RIVAL: Keep the existing taxonomy/status/thesis architecture and fix the initial encounter with spacing alone, bringing the first group heading/cards upward.
WHY ATTRACTIVE: It is the smallest visual change, adds no new projection, and preserves the existing directory composition.
FALSIFIER: Exact desktop/mobile browser review showed the mechanically correct page exposed taxonomy, status and a large thesis but no selectable Project identity. The first desktop-only spacing treatment merely moved the `Core work system` group heading into view and remained non-actionable. A canonical-data-derived quick index then exposed all eight Project identities in both initial encounters while mechanical review stayed clean.
RETAINED CONSEQUENCE: Keep the Projects-local quick index derived from the canonical `projects` array and preserve the detailed capability directory below; smoke tests assert project identity appears in the initial encounter.
COUNTERFACTUAL: Reverting to spacing-only restores a visually cleaner but task-incomplete first encounter: users see classification before any object they can select. Implementing the fix with a second manifest would instead create publication drift from canonical project data.
BOUNDARY: This is not a universal above-the-fold law and does not require every page to front-load links. It applies to this selection-dominant directory under the observed viewport/task.
REOPEN CONDITION: Reopen when inventory/task/viewport materially changes, or another directory falsifies the need for early entity exposure while preserving selection success.
